summary: Hattrick entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Hattrick

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Desktop browser capture of current service

primary.why: Hattrick is a browser-based football management live service. The browser version is the content authority, while mobile apps are convenience clients for the same account/service.
primary.how_to_play: Use Hattrick.org in a desktop browser, and record season, team/account state, country league, and date because the game is a long-running live service.

all_releases.reason: primary: full service/account route and best archive source.

all_releases.fidelity: Mobile client for the same live service.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful account-management route, but not a fuller archive route than browser.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive content split is sourced; this is an account/season-state archive problem.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service state changes by season. Archive notes should include team/account context and country league.
